value.rationale: This is not a cosmetic rounding issue. The controller’s parameter perturbation moves the equilibrium, so the local analysis and simulations in Example 7.2 are centered at a point that is not a constant solution of the printed controlled system. Recomputing the true equilibrium reverses the stated control conclusion: the first linear stability interval is slightly enlarged rather than reduced. That directly affects interpretation of the proposed bifurcation-control mechanism.
